_provenance: Site reveal prompts (Law §2.8.2) and relic recover costs (Law §5.4.2, printed in the bottom-right corner per §2.8.4), both keyed by site saveId. The vendored cards.lua carries neither; its `relicCount` field is no longer read. Hand-transcribed from the printed site card faces via the Buried Giant Studios card library (https://cards.buriedgiant.com/search?q=game:oath — see HLD.md 'Reference sources'), which renders each card at full resolution. `relics` is the top-left 'R'-icon count (Law §5.6.2 / §8.6.2). `recoverCost` is `null` for sites with `relics: 0` (they never print the icon). Two `relics` counts differ from cards.lua's `relicCount`, both NEEDING VERIFICATION against a physical copy: Salt Flats (saveId 1) — card shows 2 favor + 1 secret and NO 'R'; cards.lua said relicCount 1. Wastes (saveId 10) — card shows a single 'R'; cards.lua said 2, but the Playbook walkthrough p.25 says 'place one relic'. Recover-cost icon grammar, confirmed against two worked examples in the rulebook walkthrough (Narrow Pass = place 3 favor in the Arcane bank; Mountain = burn two favor, both p.13/p.19): a pawn+'R' tag, then either three favor-coin icons followed by a suit-bank symbol ('placeFavor'), two favor-coin icons with no suit symbol ('burnFavor'), or one or two secret-gem icons ('burnSecret'). Suit-symbol colors read off known-suit denizens: discord = red imp mask (A Small Favor et al.), hearth = orange house (Wayside Inn), nomad = green circle / tan face (Mountain Giant), arcane = purple triangle (also confirmed directly by the Narrow Pass worked example), order = blue square (Wrestlers), beast = white circle / red star (Nature Worship). saveId 20 ('Imperial Seat' in cards.lua / the 2020 TTS mod) is named 'The Tribunal' on the current printing — same rename pattern as the other P1 name overrides (see overrides.json), recorded here rather than there because this file is keyed by saveId, not name.
